Consider strategy: owning railroads is good; each gives rent based on number owned. Currently no railroads owned by anyone. Buying gives us 1/4 railroads, rent $25. Others may later buy. Having one is decent. Cash is sufficient. Likely buy to increase assets. Also we could start auction to try to get cheaper, but auction could be won by others. Usually buying is safe. So choose buy_property.

Public message: maybe say "I buy Pennsylvania Railroad." Private thought: reasoning.

Make tool call buy_property with messages.
